commentary_segments.text: It is not so easy to work out which cascode solution of the two to use. In principle, the second one is a little bit better as it takes the side of the input transistor. There are less higher-order poles and zeros in this case! Some designers take half the compensation capacitance to both sides, which is very similar indeed!

It is not so easy to work out which cascode solution of the two to use. In principle, the second one is a little bit better as it takes the side of the input transistor. There are less higher-order poles and zeros in this case! Some designers take half the compensation capacitance to both sides, which is very similar indeed!
